mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which impairs diltiazem clearance and increases cardiotoxicity risk; diltiazem may also potentiate amphotericin B's cardiac effects through additive negative inotropic activity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+, Ca2+), and cardiac status closely; maintain aggressive hydration and electrolyte supplementation; consider alternative antifungal or alternative cardiac agent if possible; monitor for increased diltiazem toxicity signs.
